title: Single-cell isolation from full-thickness human intestinal tissue resections for single-cell RNA sequencing
protocol: Rinse tissue thoroughly with chilled HBSS.
Place complete full thickness tissue on staging board, mucosal side up (serosal side down), gently blot with paper towels.
Alternate rinsing and blotting until the tissue is visibly clean of blood, debris, and mucus.
Keep the specimen wet during processing.
Work gently and quickly to maintain cell viability.
Place the blotted tissue on clean paper towels and straighten it, ensuring all layers are distinguishable.
Dissect the specimen after taking a picture.
Remove the lamina propria layer, avoiding muscle or fat tissue.
Use curved, round-ended scissors and forceps to cut strips gently at the deepest part of their curve.
Cut at least four to six strips each of at least 2 cm length.
Transfer the strips to a 100 mm Falcon petri dish with HBSS to prevent drying.
Remove any muscle tissue from the lamina propria strips using a scalpel, avoiding fat tissue.
Weigh the lamina propria strips and record their weight.
Incubate strips in DTT solution for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse strips thoroughly after incubation with DTT.
Transfer tissue strips to a 10 mL EM1-A tube containing enzyme.
Incubate EM1-A tube at 37°C for 30 minutes, inverting every 5 minutes.
Filter the contents of the EM1-A tube through a 100 μm cell strainer filter.
Transfer the partially digested tissue from the top of the strainer to an EM1-B tube containing 10 mL of enzyme solution.
Incubate EM1-B tube at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Spin the filtrate at 330 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL complete media.
Take 40 μL of EM1-A cell suspension and mix with 40 μL of Trypan Blue.
Count cells using a hemacytometer and record the number and viability.
Leave the remaining EM1-A cell suspension on ice.
After red cell lysis, count cells again for the final count.
Remove 40 μL of EM1-B cell suspension.
Mix with 40 μL of Trypan Blue.
Count cell number and viability.
Proceed to “RBC LYSIS PROTOCOL” after counting.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL of complete media after RBC lysis.
Count cell number/cell viability again.
Avoid frothing by slowly resuspending cells without introducing bubbles during mixing.
Monitor the time of digestion constantly.
Evaluate final tissue digest visually for viscous consistency, fibrous threads, and absence of obvious tissue chunks.
Weigh the amount of muscle tissue in a small weigh boat.
Transfer the muscle to a 100 mm Falcon petri dish.
Carry out all steps in a BSL2 biosafety cabinet to minimize biohazard safety exposure.
Mince the tissue using a #21 curved scalpel blade with a rocking motion.
Cut the minced tissue into small squares of approximately 2 mm².
Transfer the minced tissue from the petri dish to a 50 mL conical tube containing 10 mL of collagenase II (2 mg/mL), 2.5% PSF in RPMI (EM3).
Rinse the petri dish with about 2–3 mL of collagenase II solution and add it back to the tube.
Incubate at 37°C for 60 min, inverting the tube continuously for 30 s every 15 min.
Filter through a 100 μm pore filter after 60 min.
Transfer the partially digested tissue to a petri dish containing 10 mL of enzyme-free complete media.
Incubate at 37°C under 5% CO2 for 30 min.
Centrifuge the filtrate solution (330 × g, 5 min, and 4°C).
Resuspend the pellet in approximately 5 mL of complete media and keep on ice until further processing is completed.
Filter the partially digested tissue through a 100 μm pore cell strainer after 30-min incubation from step 26a.
Centrifuge at 330 × g, 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet in complete media and combine with muscle filtrate fraction from step 27.
Count the cell number and viability of the muscle fraction by combining 40 μL of the cell suspension with 40 μL of trypan blue.
Remove red blood cells using “RBC LYSIS PROTOCOL”.
Incubate the isolated single cell suspension at 330 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Re-suspend the pellet in working solution to achieve a concentration of 2 million cells/mL.
Incubate with RBC buffer for 5 minutes at 25°C.
Add two times volume of complete media to halt lysis and centrifuge at 330 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Wash the pellet twice more with 10 mL cold HBSS, centrifuging between washes at 330 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Re-suspend the final pellet in 5 mL of complete media and count cells.
Fix isolated single cells using chilled 1× PBS for storage and subsequent analysis.
Centrifuge 0.1–1.0 × 10^6 cells in a 15 mL round-bottom culture tube at 300 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant gently without disrupting the cell pellet and add 1 mL chilled 1× PBS using a wide-bore pipette tip.
Gently mix by pipetting 10 times until cells are completely suspended.
Spin the suspension at 300 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Repeat steps of adding PBS, mixing, and centrifuging.
Remove the supernatant without disrupting the cell pellet.
Add 200 μL chilled 1X PBS using a wide-bore pipette tip and gently pipette the mixture 10 times to suspend cells completely.
Add 800 μL chilled 100% methanol drop by drop while gently mixing on a vortex at the lowest speed setting.
Store cells at −20°C for 30 min, then transfer to −80°C for long-term storage.
Wash cells twice with cold PBS and resuspend cells in 1× Binding Buffer at a concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Transfer 100 μL of the solution (1 × 10^5 cells) to a 5 mL culture tube.
Add 5 μL of FITC Annexin V and 5 μL PI.
Gently vortex the cells and incubate for 15 min at 25°C in the dark.
Add 400 μL of 1× Binding Buffer to each tube.
Analyze by flow cytometry within 1 h.
